frontMatter.value: Create branded, durable diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG for a change, a plan or a decision, saved in the workspace's diagrams folder and linked from the record or the document they illustrate. Covers architecture, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER, timeline, waterfall, and dozens more forms; redraws .drawio, Mermaid and Excalidraw sources at a chosen size and detail.

passages.text: diagram-design is an extra habit, installed on request, for the moment a durable diagram would serve a change, a plan or a decision: a standalone HTML, SVG or PNG file saved in a folder of the workspace's diagrams folder, named by the change id or the plan name it serves, and linked from the record or the document it illustrates. Offer it in one line when a durable diagram would serve and the owner did not ask for one, and start on the owner's yes; a quick sketch that lives in the reply belongs to show-me. It writes no record of its own: the section of the step that needed the diagram links it. Everything here is invoked by asking in natural language: no plugin commands are installed, and the client-profile verbs and upstream's doctor commands do not apply.
passages.reason: The opening paragraph in the habit's own voice: the situation its block row keys it by, a durable diagram for a change, a plan or a decision under .greenline/diagrams/<work-id>/, linked from the record or the document it illustrates, offered in one line and started on the owner's yes; the sketch in the reply is show-me's; it writes no record of its own; and nothing of upstream's command surface is installed. Re-cut at S18b onto the change record, in place of an artifact, its revision, a ticket and an initiative. The doctor named is upstream's, since greenline's leaves the CLI. ## 0. First-time setup: the effective style guide

**Before generating your first diagram in a project, resolve the effective style guide.** It is the project's style guide in the diagrams folder when that file exists: unmanaged workspace state, and the only copy to edit. Otherwise it is the installed [`references/style-guide.md`](references/style-guide.md) at its shipped defaults, which the installation owns and which is never edited.

## Where its work lands

The workspace's diagrams folder is `.greenline/diagrams/`: a diagram is saved in `.greenline/diagrams/<work-id>/`, named by the change id or the plan name it serves, such as `.greenline/diagrams/2026-10-08-retry-deadline/flow.html`. The project's style guide is `.greenline/diagrams/style-guide.md`; the installed `references/style-guide.md` is the one `greenline sync` owns and never edited.
